newsitem.title: INDIA: India Apple, Whirlpool in venture.
newsitem.headline: India Apple, Whirlpool in venture.

text.p: Home appliance maker Whirlpool said on Monday it had tied up with finance firm Apple Industries to form a consumer finance company.
"This is our first foray in the area of consumer finance outside North America," Thomas Young, vice president and managing director of Whirlpool Financial, Asia, said in a statement.

Whirlpool Financial India Ltd, a unit of Whirlpool of India and parent firm Whirlpool Corporation, will hold a 40 percent stake in the new firm Whirlpool Apple Consumer Credit Private Ltd. The remaining 60 percent will be held by the Apple group.
The joint venture involves an initial investment of $13 million, according to Garrick D'Silva, CEO and president of Whirlpool South Asia.
"With the Asian market slated to be the largest regional market (40 percent of the global market), Whirlpool intends to maximise on the opportunity," Young said.
